title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up for depression.

HPI
Pt is a 76 y.o. female presenting for f/u of MDD. Pt reports persistent low mood, fatigue, and diminished interest in daily activities over the last month. She describes her symptoms as severe and persistent. She denies any perceptual disturbances and is noted to be without psychotic features at this time. Pt reports improved sleep but continues to struggle with concentration and motivation.

Medication List
Sertraline 50mg PO QD

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, cooperative.
Psych: Affect flat, mood depressed. Speech coherent. Thought process linear. Insight and judgment intact. No evidence of psychosis.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, RR 16, Temp 98.6.

Assessment
1. Major depressive disorder, recurrent. Current episode is severe without psychotic features.

Plan
1. Continue current Sertraline dosage.
2. Pt to continue monitoring mood and side effects.
3. F/u in 4 weeks for further evaluation.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe without psychotic features (HCC 155): F33.2.
